name: Lesley Chenoweth Scholarship
summary: Up to $2,000 for full-time Griffith undergraduates in financial hardship, with preference for Logan students.
key: Maximum value is $2,000, paid in two instalments.
who: Completed 40 CP of a Griffith undergraduate degree with a passing grade.
Australian citizen, permanent resident, humanitarian visa holder or New Zealand citizen.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
Upload a CV; applicants may be interviewed.
catches: Apply by Monday 19 April 2027, 4pm, for Trimester 1 2027.

evidence.quote: Maximum value is $2,000, paid in two instalments.
be able to demonstrate financial hardship.
